content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To draw accurate human body proportions, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sketch the central axis of the torso (2 minutes)
Step 2. Refine the curvature of the spine (5 minutes)
Step 3. Define the angle of the pelvic tilt (4 minutes)
Step 4. Mark the position of the knee joints (1 minute)
Step 5. Sketch the volume of the ribcage (6 minutes)
Step 6. Map the width of the shoulders (3 minutes)
Step 7. Determine the midpoint of the total height (2 minutes)
Step 8. Outline the contour of the upper arms (7 minutes)
Step 9. Measure the length of the humerus (2 minutes)
Step 10. Draw the collarbone alignment (3 minutes)
Step 11. Plot the position of the belly button (1 minute)
Step 12. Sketch the basic shape of the hands (8 minutes)
Step 13. Measure the width of three eye-lengths for the face (4 minutes)
Step 14. Mark the chin line (1 minute)
Step 15. Verify the four-head length from crown to crotch (10 minutes)
Step 16. Sharpen the charcoal pencils (2 minutes)
Step 17. Study the anatomical reference chart (15 minutes)
Step 18. Add highlights to the muscle groups (20 minutes)
Step 19. Sketch the line of action for the pose (3 minutes)
Step 20. Apply final fixative spray to the drawing (10 minutes)
Step 21. Check the vertical alignment of the ear to the shoulder (2 minutes)
Step 22. Lightly ghost in the thigh shapes (5 minutes)
Step 23. Shade the underside of the jaw (6 minutes)
Step 24. Erase the preliminary construction lines (5 minutes)
Step 25. Detail the kneecaps (9 minutes)
Step 26. Render the texture of the hair (25 minutes)
Step 27. Block in the major muscle masses (12 minutes)
Step 28. Define the silhouette of the legs (8 minutes)
Step 29. Clean the drawing surface (2 minutes)
Step 30. Soften the edges of the torso (6 minutes)
Step 31. Sketch the shape of the feet (7 minutes)
Step 32. Establish the "eight heads tall" scale (5 minutes)
Step 33. Adjust the weight distribution on the feet (4 minutes)
Step 34. Check the symmetry of the hips (3 minutes)
Step 35. Outline the calves (6 minutes)
Step 36. Verify the elbow alignment with the waist (4 minutes)
Step 37. Position the wrists relative to the crotch (3 minutes)
Step 38. Balance the negative space between limbs (5 minutes)
Step 39. Draw the connection of the neck to the shoulders (7 minutes)
Step 40. Set up the easel and lighting (10 minutes)
Step 41. Select the appropriate grade of graphite (2 minutes)
Step 42. Sketch the forearm musculature (9 minutes)
Step 43. Measure the distance between the tear ducts (2 minutes)
Step 44. Add mid-tone values to the skin (15 minutes)
Step 45. Review the perspective of the torso box (10 minutes)
Step 46. Darken the deepest shadows (12 minutes)
Step 47. Sketch the orientation of the head (5 minutes)
Step 48. Sign the bottom corner of the piece (1 minute)
Step 49. Tape the paper to the drawing board (3 minutes)
Step 50. Practice quick gesture warm-ups (15 minutes)
Step 51. Prepare the blending stumps (2 minutes)
Step 52. Refine the pectoral muscles (8 minutes)
Step 53. Locate the bottom of the ribcage (2 minutes)
Step 54. Verify the width of the pelvis (4 minutes)
Step 55. Detail the abdominal muscles (12 minutes)
Step 56. Smooth the transitions between joints (10 minutes)
Step 57. Sketch the oval for the cranium (3 minutes)
Step 58. Gather all drawing supplies (5 minutes)
Step 59. Mark the ankle bones (2 minutes)
Step 60. Measure the length of the femur (3 minutes)
Step 61. Sketch the deltoid shapes (6 minutes)
Step 62. Outline the general gesture of the body (4 minutes)
Step 63. Determine the slope of the shoulders (3 minutes)
Step 64. Check the proportion of the head to the torso (4 minutes)
Step 65. Draw the toes and heel (8 minutes)
Step 66. Indicate the direction of the light source (2 minutes)
Step 67. Perform a final proportion check (5 minutes)
Step 68. Sketch the flow of the spine from the neck (4 minutes)
Step 69. Sharpen the white chalk for highlights (2 minutes)
Step 70. Mix the primary colors for a skin tone base (10 minutes)
